an5.80:1.1: bhikkhave anāgatabhayāni etarahi asamuppannāni āyatiṃ samuppajjisanti,
an5.80:2.2: Bhavissanti bhikkhave bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ cīvare kalyāṇakāmā,
an5.80:2.3: te cīvare kalyāṇakāmā samānā riñcissanti paṃsukūlikattaṃ riñcissanti araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni
an5.80:2.4: gāmanigamarājadhāniṃ osaritvā vāsaṃ kappessanti, cīvarahetu ca anekavihitaṃ anesanaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ āpajjissanti.
an5.80:2.5: Idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ etarahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati,
an5.80:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhavissanti bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ piṇḍapāte kalyāṇakāmā,
an5.80:3.2: te piṇḍapāte kalyāṇakāmā samānā riñcissanti piṇḍapātikattaṃ riñcissanti araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni
an5.80:3.3: gāmanigamarājadhāniṃ osaritvā vāsaṃ kappessanti jivhaggena rasaggāni pariyesamānā, piṇḍapātahetu ca anekavihitaṃ anesanaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ āpajjissanti.
an5.80:3.4: Idaṃ bhikkhave dutiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ etarahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati,
an5.80:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhavissanti bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ senāsane kalyāṇakāmā,
an5.80:4.2: te senāsane kalyāṇakāmā samānā riñcissanti rukkhamūlikattaṃ riñcissanti araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni
an5.80:4.3: gāmanigamarājadhāniṃ osaritvā vāsaṃ kappessanti, senāsanahetu ca anekavihitaṃ anesanaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ āpajjissanti.
an5.80:4.4: Idaṃ bhikkhave tatiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ etarahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati,
an5.80:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhavissanti bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ bhikkhunīsikkhamānāsamaṇuddesehi saṃsaṭṭhā viharissanti,
an5.80:5.2: bhikkhunīsikkhamānāsamaṇuddesehi saṃsagge kho pana bhikkhave sati etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an5.80:5.3: anabhiratā vā brahmacariyaṃ carissanti, aññataraṃ vā saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjissanti, sikkhaṃ vā paccakkhāya hināyāvattissanti.
an5.80:5.4: Idaṃ bhikkhave catutthaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ etarahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati,
an5.80:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhavissanti bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ ārāmikasamaṇuddesehi saṃsaṭṭhā viharissanti,
an5.80:6.2: ārāmikasamaṇuddesehi saṃsagge kho pana bhikkhave sati etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an5.80:6.3: anekavihitaṃ sannidhikarakaparibhogaṃ anuyuttā viharissanti, oḷārikaṃ pi nimittaṃ karissanti paṭhaviyā pi haritagge pi.
an5.80:6.4: Idaṃ bhikkhave pañcamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ etarahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati,
an5.80:7.1: Imāni kho bhikkhave pañca anāgatabhayāni etarahi asamuppannāni āyatiṃ samuppajjissanti,
an5.80:7.3: paṭibujjhitvā ca tesaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabban ti.
